sample_unit: Google People Also Ask questions (top 50 for each of two queries)

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT 3.5 responses and website content versus recommended patient education level
links.effect: Website readability on average did not meet the recommended standard; only two websites were at or below 8th-grade level. ChatGPT readability was significantly poorer than websites (p < 0.001).
links.quote: Responses by ChatGPT had significantly poorer readability compared to the websites (p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Reading level of online cochlear implant patient materials versus recommended 8th-grade level
links.effect: Average readability did not meet the recommended standard for patient education materials; only two websites were at or below the 8th-grade level.
links.quote: Among all types of websites, readability, on average, did not meet the recommended standard for health-related patient education materials.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and readability of ChatGPT-3.5 compared to web search results in answering common patient questions about cochlear implants.
